title: white ceramic sauce bowls
text: white ceramic sauce bowls. These arrived quickly and all whole.  They included a plastic "scraper" - as noted in the ad... I washed on the top rack of the dishwasher, no problems.  They are fairly thick... I have 2 grandsons - 5 and 8.  I use them for snacks and dipping sauces for them.  They are the perfect size - a little flat - holding a couple 2 or 3 tablespoons fluid or paste.  They stack nicely.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Ceramic Side Sauce Dish and Pan Scraper, 3 Inch, 2 Ounce, Bone White, 6-Pack
